subject: english
grouping_policy: Rule: independent subquestions are separate requests; subquestions sharing conditions, passages, figures or dialogues stay together. English Q1-Q3 are sets of short independent items, but the Japanese task instruction at the top of each of these questions is required to answer every item (e.g. Q3 asks only for the 3rd and 5th words). Splitting per item would drop that instruction from the later items, so each of Q1-Q3 is sent as one unit. Reading passages/dialogues with their questions form one unit; the A and B parts of Q5 are split only when B does not refer to A. Groups defined from the problem pages only, without answer-key content.
